rows.failed_obligation: Diameter at most 2 is not necessary for eventual completion: edge additions can create new common-neighbor pairs and propagate through a graph initially having larger diameter.
rows.minimal_repair_direction: Replace the diameter argument with a valid lower-bound invariant for this closure process.
